item.title: Distinguishing the mixed conduction interphase: a machine learning molecular dynamics study on the Na3PS4/Na battery interface
item.description:
📚 Machine Learning: Science and Technology
👤 Bryant Y Li, Hwidong Jeon, Kristin A Persson
The interphase formed between solid electrolytes and alkali metal anodes determines whether decomposition is self-passivating, solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) or continuously propagating, mixed conducting interphase (MCI). We employ machine learning interatomic potential molecular dynamics to simulate the Na PS /Na interface at scales of 500 000 atoms and 10 ns. Three features distinguish this system from the passivating /Li interface: (1) P–P transport correlations enabling cooperative phosphorus migration toward the anode, (2) amorphous Na S domains lacking nanocrystalline order, and (3) persistent Na–P connectivity pathways spanning the interphase from the onset of decomposition. item.title: 钙钛矿超晶格中二维平坦极性带产生的不可约亚平方纳米铁电畴
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Pawan Kumar, Jun Hee Lee
研究发现，铁电 (BaTiO3)1/(BaXO3)1 超晶格（X = Zr、Sn）中存在二维平坦极性声子带，可在四分之一晶胞面积内形成高度局域且相互独立的偶极子。由此产生的准简并态对应不可约的亚平方纳米铁电畴，估算的铁电畴密度超过 300 Tbit/cm2，并可在低电压下独立切换。该铁电相在不同超晶格堆垛方向上都是竞争性基态，有望通过自由悬浮结构或在 MgO 衬底上的外延生长实现。

item.title: 功能化驱动的电荷重排实现超高容量 V2B MBene 锂/钠离子电池负极：第一性原理研究
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Shaiokh Bin Abi, Ahmed Zubair
研究利用第一性原理计算探讨了氮功能化二维 MBene V2BN2 作为锂离子和钠离子电池负极材料的潜力，并通过声子色散和从头算分子动力学评估其稳定性。Bader 电荷分析显示，Li/Na 吸附会引起显著电荷重排，从而增强离子与基底的相互作用。V2BN2 具有较高理论比容量、较低开路电压和较小离子迁移能垒，显示出用于下一代可充电离子电池的潜力。

item.description:

该研究探讨磁性 Lieb 晶格中轨道角动量输运与交替磁性之间的关系。作者表明，共线反铁磁织构在无自旋-轨道耦合的非相对论极限下即可实现 d 波交替磁态并产生轨道霍尔效应，其响应类似相应铁磁体。加入 SOC 后，轨道霍尔效应伴随自旋霍尔响应，交替磁性自旋纹理获得相应轨道纹理；研究还将分析扩展到奇宇称 p 波磁性，揭示各向异性轨道霍尔响应和对称横向分量。

item.title: 自旋-轨道耦合手性金属中自旋模交叉与交流 Edelstein 响应的密度矩阵量子动力学
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Shuntaro Sumita, Yusuke Kato
该研究建立了三维各向同性手性金属的密度矩阵量子动力学理论，用于描述由自旋-轨道耦合驱动的角动量动力学。理论保留带间相干性，并构造了在杂质散射中守恒电荷、能量和自旋的碰撞积分。作者识别出随 SOC 强度从弱到强连续演化的三种自旋模，并推导交流 Edelstein 磁化率及其倒易电流响应，验证了 Onsager 倒易性。

item.title: 轨道几何自旋响应：能带间相干与轨道到自旋的转换
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Dimitrie Culcer
研究表明，在中等自旋轨道耦合下，电场诱导的自旋密度包含直接项和轨道几何自旋响应，后者源于无自旋母哈密顿量的能带间相干，虽与轨道角动量有关，却并非由其直接转化而来。在有质量 Dirac 费米子中，即使净轨道角动量为零，该响应仍然存在，并可产生与直接响应方向相反的反向流。研究结果为优化轨道电子学体系提供了指导。

item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 P. Biswal, Ruma Khatun, G. Tripathy, Diptikanta Swain, D. Samal

item.title: Laser-induced metastable (anti-)skyrmion states with higher-order topological charge
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Tim Titze, Marcel Möller, Timo Schmidt, Mariam Hassan, Sabri Koraltan, Stefan Mathias 等9位作者
arXiv:2609.13112v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ultrafast creation and manipulation of topologically non-trivial spin objects promises significant potential for spintronic applications. Here, we demonstrate laser-induced nucleation of skyrmions and antiskyrmions with topological charge up to |Q|=3 from the saturated magnetization state of a Co/Ni-multilayer which does not intrinsically host a skyrmionic ground state. The resulting configuration of spin objects thus constitutes a metastable, thermodynamically hidden magnetic state. We control the number and type of spin objects by the excitation fluence and the external out-of-plane magnetic field.

👤 E Weightman, L O'Brien, S Coates
该研究考察基于八角 Ammann-Beenker 拼砌的准周期人工自旋冰，其六种顶点类型提供了周期晶格中不存在的局域环境。作者结合偶极耦合宏自旋的 Monte Carlo 模拟和单个顶点能量的微磁计算，发现顶点冻结顺序并非由配位数决定，而由五岛顶点处的准简并能级及其局域环境决定。研究还提出一种解析基态，由长程有序的固定自旋网络与稀疏简并区域共同构成。

item.title: Intrinsic longitudinal spin-conductivity from ferroaxial spin-symmetry breaking
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yue Yu, Jin Matsuda, Hikaru Watanabe, Ryotaro Arita, Daniel F. Agterberg
arXiv:2603.12330v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The interplay of antiferromagnetic order, momentum-dependent Bloch spin-splitting, time-reversal (T), and parity (P) symmetries in non-relativistic systems has emerged as a central theme for spintronics. Two well-known examples are P-preserving and T-violating altermagnets and P-violating and T-preserving odd-parity magnets. Here we examine a class of coplanar AFMs with a translation invariant vector spin chiral (VSC) order that preserves both P and T symmetries but breaks the non-relativistic spin-rotational invariance. Naively, such a VSC order is not expected to exhibit unusual phenomena. Here we show that the spin-rotational symmetry breaking generated by this VSC order can take on multiple forms, including ferroaxial symmetry breaki…

item.title: NEMO：用于弯曲和多层生物表面的向列与形态分析框架
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Konstantinos Andreadis, Oriol Mañé-Benach, Claire A. Dessalles, Lodovico Mazzei, Aurélien Roux, Guillaume Salbreux
该工作提出 NEMO，一个用于深度分辨量化切向向列有序和表面形态的模块化 Python 框架。NEMO 将生物表面重构为三角网格，投影弯曲强度层，提取局域向列指向矢，并在切平面内计算局域平均向列张量。该框架还可识别拓扑缺陷、计算拓扑荷，并量化表面间距离及曲率，作者通过合成囊泡向列膜和 Hydra 中的肌动蛋白组织展示了其能力。

👤 Kazuki Nakazawa, Henry F. Legg, Renato M. A. Dantas, Jelena Klinovaja, Daniel Loss
arXiv:2601.13510v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The coupling of spin and electronic degrees of freedom via the spin-orbit interaction (SOI) is an essential ingredient for many proposed future technologies. However, probing the strength and nature of SOI is a significant challenge, especially in heterostructures.
